overall: No violation found. The removal happened before any meeting convened, so the OML's disruption-removal procedure did not apply. The AG did encourage the Council to ask people to leave only once a meeting has convened and a clear warning has been given.

allegations.summary: Two complainants allege the Council excluded them from its March 27 open meeting by having them leave the senior center before the meeting began.
allegations.key_passage: Because the situation at hand does not fall within the scope of the Open Meeting Law, we are constrained to find that the Council did not violate the law.
